captions.text: Three teams here — Translators, Review Board, and Leadership.
Each team carries a role — give a team a project once and everyone inherits it.
And here's the roster — james.t, sofia.r, amara.k and the rest, each with a role.
Owners and admins see exactly who's on each team and what they can do.
